c041.title: An email to the professor
c041.story: Anna had to write her first [[email]] in English to a professor. She was a new [[user]] of the university mail app. She logged in to her [[account]] with her [[username]]. Then she chose a simple [[template]]. She put her name in the [[header]]. She put a [[slash]] between the day and the month. Then she attached her homework in PDF [[format]]. All evening she checked her [[inbox]], but nothing came. Max said, "Maybe his [[reply]] is in [[spam]]." He was right! The professor thanked her and sent a [[link]] to a reading list.

c042.title: Train tickets online
c042.story: Anna wanted train tickets to Lviv, so she tried an [[online service]]. Max found it on the [[web]] for her. The [[website]] opened very slowly in her phone [[browser]]. So she opened the [[site]] in the [[web browser]] on her laptop. The [[layout]] was confusing, and she could not find the tickets. While [[browsing]], she closed three [[pop-ups|pop-up]]. Finally, with one [[click]], she bought tickets for her and Max. Then she entered the [[code]] from a text message. She took a [[screenshot]] of the [[QR code]] for the trip. On the train, the conductor checked her phone. Anna showed him a [[scan]] of her student card too. Everything was fine, and the trip began.

c043.title: Max's new flat goes online
c043.story: Max's new flat had no internet. On Monday, a technician from his [[provider]] came. He brought a [[router]] and a [[modem]]. He fixed a bad [[connector]] and moved the [[antenna]] on the roof. Then Max made a small [[home office]] in his bedroom. His new [[setup]] had a [[headset]] and a big [[monitor]]. Its [[display]] was bright and clear. He also got a good [[microphone]] for video calls. He bought an old [[printer]], but it needed a new [[cartridge]]. Anna brought him her old [[scanner]] as a housewarming gift. "Now I can work from home!" Max said happily.

c044.title: Anna's family tree
c044.story: Anna draws her family tree for Max. Her parents and two [[siblings|sibling]] are on it. Her brother Taras calls her "[[sis]]." She calls him "[[bro]]." Aunt Olha is in her last [[trimester]]. The [[placenta]] and the [[baby]] are healthy. Soon Anna has a new [[cousin]]! "Your [[clan]] is very big!" Max says. Grandpa is an old admiral, now a [[pensioner]]. [[Mama|mama]] laughs and says, "Grandpa is a true [[optimist]]." "And Grandma is a [[realist]]," Anna adds. "You are just like Grandpa," Max smiles.

c045.title: A surprise party for Mama
c045.story: Anna and her brother Taras planned a [[surprise]] party for Mama's birthday. They sent an [[invite]] to the whole family. Taras ordered a big [[bouquet]] from a [[florist]] near their home. When Mama came home, everyone shouted and threw [[confetti]]. Anna found old family pictures in a dusty [[photo album]]. She glued the best ones into a colorful [[scrapbook]] for Mama. Mama cried happy tears. Her friend Lida brought a cake with coffee [[liqueur]]. Then they all sang [[karaoke]] until late. Mama paid her kids a sweet [[compliment]]: "You are the best!"
